name: Extra Terrors [Psionic]
body:
You can use your terrors more than normal.

Prerequisite: Terrors class feature.

Benefit: You gain 3 additional daily uses of your terrors.

Special: You can gain Extra Terrors multiple times. Its effects stack. Each time you take the feat, you gain three additional daily uses of your terrors.
